messages:
Clara Nguyen: Dropping a new compact row iteration for latency panels — big p95, tiny throughput sparkline beneath, and a small 'Sampling' badge on the top-right that opens an inline popover. Attached quick mock. Thoughts on keyboard nav and accessible labels? :wave: Devon Park: I like the density. A couple quick asks: always show throughput unit 'RPS', badge should display current state (e.g., 'Sampling: Adaptive' or 'Sampling: 10%') so users don't need to open it. Also tooltip on sparkline with exact numeric RPS on hover. :eyes: Ravi Patel: Accessibility checklist: badge must be tabbable, include aria-expanded and aria-controls. Popover should use role="dialog" (not menu) because it contains sliders and toggles. Announce open with a live region: "Sampling settings opened. Currently Adaptive at 10%". Announce slider changes politely. Lena Ortiz: Microcopy: prefer "Sampling: Adaptive" (capitalize). Popover title: "Sampling settings". Help link text: "What is sampling?" linking to docs. If showing estimated cost, prefix with 'Estimated' and include tiny clarifier: 'For rendered traces only; not a billing statement.' Jorge Morales: Layout concern: in narrow columns this is tight. Option: collapse throughput to an icon-only affordance that expands on click; mobile should show p95 only. Also hide est. cost by default and add an opt-in 'Show est. cost' toggle inside the popover. Samira Lee: Product note: we should avoid ambiguous billing language. If we include est. cost, include exact copy to be reviewed by finance: "Estimated render cost for sampled traces; not billed." Good to have opt-in toggle so it doesn't alarm users. DesignBot: automated-lint: contrast-warning on badge microcopy at current token color; recommend stronger color token or bolder font weight. Tag: design-accessibility. :robot_face: Clara Nguyen: Agreed actions: 1) Badge shows state, keyboard-focusable, aria snippet for front-end. 2) Popover uses role="dialog" and live region announcements. 3) Throughput shows unit and hover tooltip. 4) Estimated cost hidden behind opt-in toggle. I'll update the figma and post link when ready. Clara Nguyen: ARIA snippet for devs to implement: ```

Sampling settings

``` Devon Park: I'll add keyboard shortcut notes: 't' toggles time picker; left/right moves range, Shift+left/right jumps larger intervals. Add to keyboard shortcuts doc. Ravi Patel: I'll draft live-region copy for slider updates. Clara Nguyen: Thanks — will post updated figma link and final copy later today. :raised_hands: DesignBot: auto-archiver: thread labeled design-review; remember to attach final figma link.
